title: Psyche graph v1 (experimental, unpublished)
description: Structural schema for one psyche.graph.v1 document as accepted by psyche_core::contracts::decode_document. Experimental under #11: not a released artifact and not a stable contract. The schema accepts every document the typed decoder accepts, except the decoder-only encodings listed in docs/protocol/RECORD-SCHEMAS.md (a unit enum variant as a one-member object, a closed object as a positional array), which it rejects on purpose. It cannot express the parser-only rules listed in docs/protocol/RECORD-SCHEMAS.md, so a document that passes this schema is not thereby valid. Only the typed decoder decides validity.
